editor.hstg_permissions.tooltip.commands: Commands that belong to this stage: whoever has it may use them, nobody else may
editor.hstg_permissions.problem.bad_path: %1$s is not a command path. Write it like minecraft.gamemode.creative, mod.* or *.
editor.hstg_permissions.problem.protecte: %1$s is on the protected list. This stage can take it away, but whoever has the stage still needs to be an operator. The list is in the server config.
editor.hstg_permissions.problem.never_lo: %1$s belongs to History Stages or HSTG: Permissions. A stage can give it, but never take it away.
editor.hstg_permissions.problem.always_v: %1$s can neither be given nor taken by a stage. It always keeps Minecraft's own operator check.
editor.hstg_permissions.problem.not_foun: %1$s does not exist on this server. A typo, or the mod is missing. The entry stays and works once the command exists.
editor.hstg_permissions.picker.unavailab: This server sends no command list.
config.hstg_permissions.settings.title: HSTG: Permissions
config.hstg_permissions.settings.lockedM: What a player sees when they type a command that belongs to a stage they don't have. Own message: the text below. Like vanilla: Minecraft's "Unknown command", as if the command didn't exist.
{stage} is the missing stage (??? if it hides its name), {command} what was typed, & starts a colour code. Clear the field for the translated default.
config.hstg_permissions.settings.protect: Commands a stage can take away but never hand out.
command.hstg_permissions.check.minecraft: No stage decides /%2$s for %1$s, and Minecraft allows it
No stage decides /%2$s for %1$s, and Minecraft does not allow it (operators only)
command.hstg_permissions.check.unreadabl: /%2$s is not a valid command on this server
command.hstg_permissions.check.note.prot: · On the protected list: a stage can take it away, but not give it.
command.hstg_permissions.check.note.neve: · Belongs to History Stages or HSTG: Permissions: it can never be locked.
command.hstg_permissions.verbose.on.all: Verbose is on: you see every command any player runs.

settings.hstg_permissions.rank.title: Rank

settings.hstg_permissions.rank.suffix: Suffix after the name (& for colours)
settings.hstg_permissions.rank.priority: Priority (the highest rank a player has wins)
config.hstg_permissions.settings.rankInC: Prefix and suffix of a player's rank stage in front of and behind their name in chat. Turn it off if another mod already formats the chat.
config.hstg_permissions.settings.rankInT: Show ranks in the tab list
Prefix and suffix in the player list you see when holding Tab.
config.hstg_permissions.settings.rankInN: Prefix and suffix on the name above a player's head. Only players who have this addon installed see it.
